title: Youth-led protests over living costs sweep France and Germany
caption:
Hundreds of thousands of mostly young people protested in France on Saturday, the third weekend of marches over living costs and school conditions, with hundreds arrested. The movement spread to more than 30 German cities, where police used water cannon in Cologne. Similar youth-led protests have been growing across Europe in recent weeks.

One story. Twice a day. Follow for the next edition.
